Cam: quick FYI I opened a small PR to harmonize streaming + pagination snippets across py/ts/go and add a tiny retry helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120

docs-bot: PR 5120 opened by Cam — title: 'samples: harmonize async streaming + pagination migration notes'

Inez: Skimmed the PR. Overall great — some nits: 1) TS still shows old event callbacks, prefer async iterators (`for await`) 2) Python demo catches broad exceptions, we should show an explicit retry/backoff helper with jitter 3) add a one-line migration note for pagination cursor moving into the JSON body

Omar: I'll take TS + Go. For Go I prefer a compact channel + context example (more idiomatic and easy to reason about). Keep snippets <= 12 lines each.

Cam: Proposed checklist: (a) Python -> async generator + concise with_backoff helper (b) TypeScript -> for-await-of iterator (c) Go -> channel + ctx pattern (d) Pagination note: new runtime returns `next_cursor` in JSON body (not headers) (e) fix stale streaming link on overview page

Inez: Python helper idea (very compact):
```python
async def with_backoff(gen_fn, *a, **kw):
  for i in range(3):
    try:
      async for chunk in gen_fn(*a, **kw): yield chunk; return
    except TransientError:
      await asyncio.sleep(min(0.5*2**i, 5) + random.random())
```

Cam: TS iterator example suggestion:
```ts
async function demo(){
  const s = client.asyncGenerate({prompt:'Hello'})
  for await (const part of s) process.stdout.write(part.text)
}
```

Omar: Go channel pattern (compact):
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
ch := make(chan string)
go func(){ defer close(ch); for c := range client.AsyncGenerate(ctx, prompt){ ch<-c.Text }}()
for s := range ch { fmt.Print(s) }
```

Inez: For pagination migration add a one-liner per language, e.g.:
Python: `cursor = resp.get('next_cursor')`
TS: `const cursor = resp.next_cursor`
Go: `cursor := resp.NextCursor`

Cam: Also note in the streaming overview that `async_generate` is recommended when you need partial tokens streamed to the client; `sync_generate` is still fine for short outputs or when you need the full response atomically. One sentence only.

Omar: I'll push TS + Go updates and fix the overview link redirect.

Inez: I'll update the Python snippet and swap the broad except to the named TransientError comment. Also added a 1-line comment about cursor TTL (server may expire cursors after ~5 minutes).
